what_it_shows: Home audio opens with 19+ sub-categories: Receivers & Amplifiers, Home Speakers, Computer Audio, TV Sound Solutions, Audio Components, Turntables & Accessories, DACs, Preamps & Power Amps, High-resolution Audio, Home Stereo, Multi-room Audio, Smart Home, Table Radios & Stereo Systems, Power Protection, Headphones, Karaoke, Cables, Accessories; TVs and headphones are separate top-level departments

TV & Audio has 16 children: Fernseher, Beamer (projector), Audiokomponenten, DVD/Blu-ray, Radios, Kopfhorer, Audio-Systeme, Lautsprecher, Car Hi-Fi, accessories, Portable Audio, TV reception, DJ equipment & instruments, Vinyl; accessories split per host device

Recommended Components: categories (digital processors, preamps, power amps, integrated amps, loudspeakers, subwoofers, headphones, complete systems, cables, accessories) each ranked Class A (A+ for hi-res/turntable/phono/headphones), B, C, D; class by performance incl. test bench, price not explicit
IEM ranking: rank S-/A/B/C/D/F tiers, separate Tone Grade and Technical Grade, value star rating, driver setup (e.g. 2EST 4BA 1DD), signature, MSRP, status; a single-reviewer consensus tier

TV family tree: two roots LED(LCD) and OLED; LED has VA and IPS(ADS) sub-types; OLED has WOLED and QD-OLED; Mini LED, QLED, Micro LED, RGB Mini LED are listed as other/marketing types; marketing names per maker (QNED, ULED, Triluminos)

Digital audio player (DAP) category: facets for storage medium, capacity, playback time, hi-res, Bluetooth, balanced output; maker and series facets (WALKMAN A/WM1/ZX series); spec filters DAC, amp, Bluetooth codec (LDAC, aptX); user review and ranking sub-pages
Audio top category page (only maker chips Sony Panasonic Toshiba JVC Yamaha Sennheiser and related categories audio software, batteries, power strips, instruments); tree itself not rendered

ASR electronics list: device-type vocabulary (ADC/Soundcard, CD Player, DAC (Dedicated), Headphone Amp (Dongle), Headphone AMP, DAC+Headphone AMP, Power AMP, Amplifier, AVR/AVP (Pre Pro)); one spec number (SINAD in dB) plus Recommended yes/no; 1,431 records

HS 8518 groups loudspeakers (single/multiple in enclosure), headphones and earphones, audio amplifiers, sound amplifier sets with microphones; 8519 record players; 8521 video players; 8522 pickup cartridges as parts; 8527 radio receivers; 8528 monitors, projectors, TV receivers

Headphone form factors (circumaural, supra-aural, earbud, in-ear), open/semi-open/closed back, wired vs wireless/TWS, noise isolation/cancellation, transducer types (moving-coil, electrostatic, electret, planar magnetic, balanced armature, others)
r/headphones classification: backing (open/closed), form factors (circumaural, supra-aural, universal IEM, custom IEM), then transducer technology (planar magnetic etc.)
